title: Craft beam lasers over nuclear stockpiles at Loring AFB
place_text: Loring Air Force Base, northern Maine

tellings.quote: They had a a episode. It was either 1975 or 1976 where craft were coming over the base and these laser type beams were coming out and they were mapping the nuclear stockpiles.

plain: In 1975 or 1976, unknown craft flew over Loring Air Force Base in northern Maine and shot laser-like beams down, as if mapping where the nuclear weapons were stored. Charlie Foltz tells this in summary, without naming a source. If true, it would mean something was surveying America's nuclear arms.
